name: QSM Data Generator
summary: Simulates T2*-weighted magnitude and phase images and a ground-truth susceptibility map from a synthetic cylinder phantom with qsm-forward, for testing QSM pipelines such as QSMxT.
description: Generates a susceptibility phantom (a large cylinder with four smaller cylinders of different susceptibility) at the chosen matrix size and voxel size, runs the qsm-forward forward model with the given TR, TE, flip angle, field strength and field direction, and exports the simulated magnitude and phase images, the ground-truth chi map, a segmentation and a mask. Use it to create test data with known ground truth for QSM methods; it takes no input data. The README is the unmodified python App template, and the code fixes the peak SNR at 100.

outputs.description: Ground truth susceptibility map (Chi or χ).
